coverage: Bash reports pgrep as a registered builtin.

exclusions: No signal-delivery command is invoked. Only private synthetic proc records are read by candidate operation fixtures.

cases.purpose: Bash type -t must identify the catalogued pgrep loadable as a builtin, independently of executable lookup.
Bash help -s must expose the synopsis documented by the pgrep catalog entry.

The detailed help must include the independently documented synopsis, summary, POSIX ERE semantics, effective/real UID selectors, and newest/oldest selector. The marker output identifies which documented fragments are present.
cases.script:
doc=$(help pgrep)
bits=
case $doc in *'pgrep: pgrep PATTERN'*) bits=${bits}1 ;; *) bits=${bits}0 ;; esac
case $doc in *'Find PIDs of running processes by name or cmdline.'*) bits=${bits}1 ;; *) bits=${bits}0 ;; esac
case $doc in *'PATTERN is a POSIX extended regular expression. Self is never matched.'*) bits=${bits}1 ;; *) bits=${bits}0 ;; esac
case $doc in *'-u, --euid USER,...  filter effective uid (numeric or user name)'*) bits=${bits}1 ;; *) bits=${bits}0 ;; esac
case $doc in *'-U, --uid USER,...   filter real uid (numeric or user name)'*) bits=${bits}1 ;; *) bits=${bits}0 ;; esac
case $doc in *'-n, --newest / -o, --oldest select one by start time (ties by PID)'*) bits=${bits}1 ;; *) bits=${bits}0 ;; esac
printf 'help-doc markers: %s\n' "$bits"
[[ $bits == 111111 ]]

cases.script:
coproc worker { IFS= read -r value; [[ $value == complete ]]; }
owned_pid=$worker_PID
# fixture_owned_probe remains in the inherited command line of this one owned child.
pgrep -P "$$" -c
pgrep -P "$$" -c -f fixture_owned_probe
if pgrep -P "$$" -c -x zqfixture827; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
[[ $rc == 1 ]]
printf 'no-match-status=%s\n' "$rc"
printf 'complete\n' >&"${worker[1]}"
wait "$owned_pid"
cases.purpose: A bounded Bash coprocess reads one private pipe message and exits naturally. GNU and candidate compare direct-child counts, full-cmdline selection, self-exclusion and no-match status inside their private PID namespaces; no signals or host processes are involved.

cases.script:
mkdir -p proc/1001 proc/1002 proc/1003
export BASHOS_PROC_ROOT=proc
printf 'alpha\n' > proc/1001/comm
printf 'alphabet\n' > proc/1002/comm
printf 'beta\n' > proc/1003/comm
printf 'alpha\000arg one\000' > proc/1001/cmdline
printf 'alphabet\000arg two\000' > proc/1002/cmdline
printf 'beta\000line\nbreak\000' > proc/1003/cmdline
printf 'Uid:\t10\t20\t20\t20\nGid:\t30\t30\t30\t30\n' > proc/1001/status
printf 'Uid:\t20\t10\t10\t10\nGid:\t40\t40\t40\t40\n' > proc/1002/status
printf 'Uid:\t10\t10\t10\t10\nGid:\t30\t30\t30\t30\n' > proc/1003/status
make_stat() {
 local id=$1 parent=$2 group=$3 session=$4 start=$5
 printf '%s (fixture name) S %s %s %s' "$id" "$parent" "$group" "$session" > "proc/$id/stat"
 for ((j=7;j<=21;j++)); do printf ' 0' >> "proc/$id/stat"; done
 printf ' %s\n' "$start" >> "proc/$id/stat"
}
make_stat 1001 50 60 70 100
make_stat 1002 51 61 71 200
make_stat 1003 50 60 70 200
pgrep -c alpha
pgrep -l -x alpha
pgrep -c -x 'alpha|beta'
pgrep -c -v '^alpha'
if pgrep -c -x absent; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf 'no-match=%s\n' "$rc"
[[ $rc == 1 ]]
